validation_rules.three_plane_separation: System must not infer authority from transport layer alone. Requires cryptographic proof of content_author identity.
validation_rules.identity_confusion_test: If transport_principal ≠ content_author and content_author ≠ human_principal, escalate to HUMAN_REQUIRED (T7 test)
validation_rules.speaker_identity_chain: Must be contiguous. Null indicates chain break (no further actor). E.g., ['github', 'chatgpt', null] = incomplete (no human oversight).
